meta.name: King of the Zombies
meta.description:
Three men in a plane searching the Caribbean for a missing admiral crash-land on an island where voodoo is practiced and zombies roam. They soon find a mansion occupied by a family of Austrian refugees, headed by Dr. Sangre. Dr. Sangre is up to no good, and when he learns of the men's mission they begin to disappear.

Stars: Dick Purcell, Joan Woodbury, and Mantan Moreland
